objective: Implement a proof-oriented capital intelligence nucleus joining M&A, capital allocation and public-market intelligence under strict authority separation.

acceptance_criteria: deployment promotion blocked without runtime proof
builds.next_executable_action: Run repository CI and independent source readback through governed PR.

builds.gap_statement: No target production runtime has yet supplied native health, persistence and rollback proof for CIOS.

builds.interim_workaround: Keep core provider-neutral and deployable; do not claim DEPLOYED.

builds.closure_criteria: Target runtime receipt plus health, persistence, rollback and security evidence.
